office_eg08_decoded_pack_reuse.conclusion: Exact decoded-pack reuse is not a material Office creation fix. It preserved the second archive read, physical pack SHA-256, logical/canonical tree checks and corruption rejection but recovered only 2.16 ms median (2.92%). Pivot to graph/compression construction rather than verifier decode reuse.

shifted_prefixgraph_candidate_phase_rss.conclusion: After bounded result retention, isolated PrefixGraph still exceeds full shipping RSS on Shifted while G0-G4 is only about 9.3% of shipping RSS. Worker-count pressure was a valid isolated frontier but still required product-boundary confirmation.

shifted_prefixgraph_two_worker_product_d.engineering_decision: Restore four PrefixGraph audition workers globally to recover the measured candidate throughput loss. Retain bounded winner-plus-inflight ownership because that removes complete-candidate-list retention without changing bytes.
shifted_prefixgraph_two_worker_product_d.conclusion: The large isolated RSS reduction from capping PrefixGraph at two workers did not transfer to the shipping product boundary: Shifted remained around 274 MiB incremental / 397 MiB operation peak and 3.38x the accepted-v0.29 RSS gate. Keeping the cap would pay about 4.6% isolated PrefixGraph wall-time cost without retiring the release RSS blocker.

claim_boundary: Historical exact-head diagnostic evidence only. These observations can falsify an optimization and justify removing its global resource cost, but cannot authorize release. The restored four-worker schedule remains subject to exact-head byte identity, runtime/RSS, recovery/locality, native/Android and final authority.
